Taylor Fritz: Taylor Fritz enters this match in strong form following his 100th Masters 1000 win against Arthur Fils and a subsequent narrow defeat to Carlos Alcaraz at the Paris Masters, where he squandered match points. That loss to Alcaraz ultimately ended his hopes of qualifying for the ATP Finals. Following the tournament, Fritz was placed in the Stockholm draw, where he is set to face Cameron Norrie in the second round.
Holger Rune: Holger Rune recently returned to Stockholm—the site of his horrific and scary Achilles injury suffered in 2025—with a statement opening win and a subsequent victory over Miomir Kecmanovic. These wins have brought him into his 40th career quarter-final, showing strong form as he continues his comeback.
Ugo Humbert: Ugo Humbert started his Stockholm title hunt by avoiding an upset against Adolfo Daniel Vallejo, surviving nine breaks to reach the second round. He has now set up a last-16 clash in the tournament against qualifier Borna Gojo.
Lorenzo Musetti: Lorenzo Musetti enters this match in strong form following a win over Alexander Zverev at the Paris Masters and an easy victory against Toby Samuel to reach the Stockholm Open quarterfinals. However, he missed a significant chance earlier at the Paris tournament.
